null.strata: sort selected curves by conductor then ASCII label; stratum=floor(10*i/n)

sample.method: compute SHA-256 of each canonical UTF-8 Cremona label, sort by unsigned 32-byte digest then ASCII label, take first 1024

point_cloud.arithmetic: exact discriminant and integer conductor/rank then binary64 log
point_cloud.normalization: fixed as specified; no data-fitted scaler
point_cloud.degenerate_points: retain coincident points and zero-length edges

filtration.edge_appearance: at Euclidean edge length epsilon, not radius epsilon/2
filtration.finite_deaths: exactly n-1 (including zero-length), equivalent to minimum-spanning-tree edge weights with deterministic tie handling
filtration.software_independent_check: MST and independent H0 persistence implementation

endpoint.sidedness: larger T means tighter three-dimensional clustering

inference.multiple_testing: cannot be combined with A01/A03 as uncorrected family; a dedicated family-level analysis would require prospective joint adjustment

stops: MST vs independent H0 mismatch outside 1e-10
attempt to change null or filtration
